verifications.claim: Duke University is located in Durham, North Carolina.

verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly state the location as Durham, North Carolina.

verifications.claim: Duke University is a private research university.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "top research university and is now one of the wealthiest private institutions" (R1); "private research university located in Durham" (R3); "globally renowned private research institution" (R6)
verifications.reasoning: Sources explicitly describe Duke as a private research university or equivalent.

verifications.claim: Duke University is known as the "Harvard of the South."
verifications.label: CLEAR
